sources.skills: M6 14 the derived incoming (live ladder57 2026-11-17 10:42:05 UTC: five Nubilous Golems derived at 4.3 a second each against fight-sim's 0.8 to 1.5): the skills ACE's two defence rolls read of a creature, every creature weenie (weenie.type 10) of the world database (ace_world, the server's own copy), read with one read-only SELECT through server/runtime/mariadb-ace.cnf on 2026-11-17 (23,110 rows of 5,912 weenies): SELECT s.object_Id, s.type, s.init_Level, s.level_From_P_P, s.s_a_c FROM ace_world.weenie_properties_skill s JOIN ace_world.weenie w ON w.class_Id = s.object_Id AND w.type = 10 WHERE s.type IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 31, 32, 33, 34, 41, 43, 44, 45, 46, 47) ORDER BY s.object_Id, s.type. A spell of a school lands on her when ACE's MagicDefenseCheck passes (WorldObject_Magic.cs:104-113, TryResistSpell 119-168 @95ef426d: its skill in the spell's school against her Magic Defense at 0.03); a physical attack is evaded at 1 - GetSkillChance(its attack skill, her Melee or Missile Defense) (DamageEvent.GetEvadeChance, DamageEvent.cs:386-397), its attack skill its weapon's WeaponSkill, else Unarmed Combat, converted to the post-MoA skill when its init_Level is 0 (Creature_Combat.GetCurrentWeaponSkill, Creature_Combat.cs:426-457).
sources.skill_columns: per wcid, its rows [skill, init_Level, level_From_P_P, s_a_c] for the skills 1 to 13 (the retired weapon skills and Unarmed Combat), 31 Creature, 32 Item, 33 Life, 34 War, 41 Two-Handed, 43 Void, 44 Heavy, 45 Light, 46 Finesse and 47 Missile Weapons; a skill with no row is ACE's default (init 0, untrained)
sources.weapons: the WeaponSkill (weenie_properties_int 48) of every weapon_wcid and launcher_wcid of creatures.json, one read-only SELECT on 2026-11-17 (317 rows): SELECT object_Id, value FROM ace_world.weenie_properties_int WHERE type = 48 AND object_Id IN (<the 321 weapon and launcher wcids of creatures.json>) ORDER BY object_Id
sources.scope: M6 item 16 E1e (2026-11-17): the table is written by the generator now (pwsh -File tools/fight-sim.ps1 bestiary; the columns are listed in tools/fight-sim/BestiaryTables.cs), which reads the same rows through ACE's own models, queries only. The SELECT quoted above is the first extraction's and takes weenie.type 10 only; the generator also takes weenie.type 15 (WeenieType.Cow), which ACE builds as a Creature subclass (Source/ACE.Server/WorldObjects/Cow.cs:7, Source/ACE.Server/Factories/WorldObjectFactory.cs:49-50 @95ef426d) that a generator places and a player can fight: the world database holds 17 such weenies (the Low B belt's cattle among them, weenie classes 20, 181 and 182). Added: their 17 skill rows (their weapons add none); the table now holds the skills of 5,929 weenies and 317 weapons. No other row changed (bestiary --check before the refresh: 0 with a different row). The other weenie types ACE builds as a Creature subclass are left out, each with why in tools/fight-sim/BestiaryRows.cs (AceIds.LeftOut): Vendor (1,179 weenies), CombatPet (259), Pet (29) and GamePiece (12).
